title: Fortilin binds and stabilizes MEF2C, activates it through phosphorylation, and drives transcription of the cell structural and survival protein CTNNA3.
authors: Nakashima, Mari; Mukherjee, Sandipan; Pinkaew, Decha; Pal, Uttariya; van Hengel, Jolanda; Berx, Geert; Fujise, Ken
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Fortilin与转录因子MEF2C的蛋白-DNA转录调控互作，包含分子对接和结合界面突变验证，但核心是蛋白-蛋白结合及转录共激活，而非TF-DNA结合位点或互作机制建模，方法上仅用分子对接，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Fortilin, a 172 amino acid modulator protein that positively regulates survival and growth pathways, is one of the most abundantly expressed proteins in the heart, and its loss leads to lethal heart failure. While fortilin binds and protects catenin alpha-3 (CTNNA3)-a cardiomyocyte structural and survival protein-against degradation, its role in the transcriptional regulation of CTNNA3 has remained unknown. Here, we report that fortilin also promotes CTNNA3 transcription. Mechanistically, we found that fortilin specifically bound to the N-terminal region (amino acids 1-85) of myocyte enhancer factor 2C (MEF2C)-a transcription factor that drives CTNNA3 expression-but not to MEF2A, MEF2B, or MEF2D, as shown by microscale thermophoresis, proximity ligation assay, and in vitro and in vivo coimmunoprecipitation Western blot analyses. Molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis identified a critical binding interface involving aspartic acid 25 of fortilin, whereby an aspartic acid 25-to-alanine mutation markedly weakened binding to MEF2C. In addition, fortilin protected MEF2C against ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation and promoted MEF2C serine 59 phosphorylation, a modification essential for its transcriptional activity, both in a binding-dependent manner. Loss of fortilin significantly impaired MEF2C binding to nuclear DNA, reduced CTNNA3 promoter-driven luciferase activity in an MEF2C-dependent fashion, and lowered RNA polymerase II occupancy on the CTNNA3 locus. These data suggest that fortilin is a previously unrecognized transcriptional cofactor of MEF2C. By stabilizing MEF2C and promoting its activating phosphorylation, fortilin enhances the transcription of CTNNA3 while simultaneously stabilizing CTNNA3 protein, thereby sustaining CTNNA3 expression and supporting myocardial structural integrity.
abstract_zh: Fortilin是一种由172个氨基酸组成的调节蛋白，正向调控生存和生长通路，是心脏中表达最丰富的蛋白质之一，其缺失会导致致命性心力衰竭。尽管fortilin结合并保护catenin alpha-3（CTNNA3）——一种心肌细胞结构和生存蛋白——免受降解，但其在CTNNA3转录调控中的作用此前尚不清楚。在此，我们报道fortilin也促进CTNNA3的转录。机制上，我们发现fortilin特异性结合肌细胞增强因子2C（MEF2C）的N端区域（氨基酸1-85）——一种驱动CTNNA3表达的转录因子——但不结合MEF2A、MEF2B或MEF2D，这通过微量热泳动、邻近连接实验以及体外和体内共免疫沉淀Western blot分析得到证实。分子对接和定点突变鉴定了一个关键结合界面，涉及fortilin的天冬氨酸25，其中天冬氨酸25至丙氨酸的突变显著削弱了与MEF2C的结合。此外，fortilin保护MEF2C免受泛素化和蛋白酶体降解，并促进MEF2C丝氨酸59磷酸化——这一修饰对其转录活性至关重要——两者均以结合依赖的方式进行。Fortilin的缺失显著损害MEF2C与核DNA的结合，以MEF2C依赖的方式降低CTNNA3启动子驱动的荧光素酶活性，并降低RNA聚合酶II在CTNNA3基因座上的占据。这些数据表明，fortilin是MEF2C的一个先前未被识别的转录辅因子。通过稳定MEF2C并促进其激活磷酸化，fortilin增强CTNNA3的转录，同时稳定CTNNA3蛋白，从而维持CTNNA3表达并支持心肌结构完整性。
